responsibility: Defines the concrete global linkage-mode state for the GNU Modula-2 boot runtime’s M2LINK module. In this pge-boot configuration it hardwires static-scaffold behavior by providing the storage for the exported `M2LINK_StaticInitialization` flag and optional `M2LINK_ForcedModuleInitOrder` string used by the module-dependency runtime to control initialization ordering, but contains no additional startup logic of its own.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation/definition file for the GM2LINK interface: in pge-boot it allocates and initializes the exported linkage-state globals to static-scaffold defaults (`M2LINK_StaticInitialization = 1` and `M2LINK_ForcedModuleInitOrder = NULL`). Unlike `GM2LINK.h`, it does not declare the API for consumers; it provides the single storage instance those declarations refer to.
